In [[hyperbolic geometry]], the '''order-5 cubic honeycomb''' is one of four compact [[regular polytope|regular]] space-filling [[tessellation]]s (or [[honeycomb (geometry)|honeycomb]]s) in [[Hyperbolic space|hyperbolic 3-space]]. With [[Schläfli symbol]] {{math|{4,3,5},}} it has five [[cube]]s {{math|{4,3} }} around each [[Edge (geometry)|edge]], and 20 cubes around each [[Vertex (geometry)|vertex]]. It is [[Dual polytope|dual]] with the [[order-4 dodecahedral honeycomb]].

{{Honeycomb}}

== Description ==
[[File:H2-5-4-primal.svg|200px|thumb|It is analogous to the 2D hyperbolic [[order-5 square tiling]], {4,5}]]
{| class=wikitable style="width:600px"
|[[File:Order-5 cubic honeycomb cell.png|200px]]<BR>One cell, centered in Poincare ball model
|style=vertical-align:top|[[Image:Hyperb_gcubic_hc_constr.png|200px]]<BR>Main cells
|[[Image:Hyperb_gcubic_hc.png|200px]]<BR>Cells with extended edges to ideal boundary
|}

== Symmetry ==
It has a radical subgroup symmetry construction with [[regular dodecahedron|dodecahedral]] fundamental domains: [[Coxeter notation#Extended symmetry|Coxeter notation]]: [4,(3,5)<sup>*</sup>], index 120.

== Related polytopes and honeycombs ==

The order-5 cubic honeycomb has a related [[Alternation (geometry)|alternated]] honeycomb, {{CDD|node_h1|4|node|3|node|5|node}} ↔ {{CDD|nodes_10ru|split2|node|5|node}}, with [[regular icosahedron|icosahedron]] and [[tetrahedron]] cells.

The honeycomb is also one of four regular compact honeycombs in 3D hyperbolic space:
{{Regular compact H3 honeycombs}}

There are [[Convex uniform honeycombs in hyperbolic space#.5B5.2C3.2C4.5D family|fifteen uniform honeycombs]] in the [5,3,4] [[Coxeter group]] family, including the order-5 cubic honeycomb as the regular form:
{{534 family}}

The order-5 cubic honeycomb is in a sequence of [[regular polychora]] and honeycombs with [[regular icosahedron|icosahedral]] [[vertex figure]]s.
{{Icosahedral vertex figure tessellations}}

It is also in a sequence of [[regular polychora]] and honeycombs with [[cube|cubic]] [[cell (geometry)|cells]]. The first polytope in the sequence is the [[tesseract]], and the second is the Euclidean [[cubic honeycomb]].
{{Cubic cell tessellations}}

In 3-dimensional hyperbolic geometry, the '''alternated order-5 cubic honeycomb''' is a uniform compact space-filling [[tessellation]] (or [[honeycomb (geometry)|honeycomb]]). With [[Schläfli symbol]] h{4,3,5}, it can be considered a [[quasiregular honeycomb]], alternating [[regular icosahedron|icosahedra]] and [[tetrahedron|tetrahedra]] around each vertex in an [[icosidodecahedron]] vertex figure.

[[File:Alternated order 5 cubic honeycomb.png|480px]]
{{Clear}}

==== Related honeycombs ====
It has 3 related forms: the [[cantic order-5 cubic honeycomb]], {{CDD|node_h1|4|node|3|node_1|5|node}}, the [[runcic order-5 cubic honeycomb]], {{CDD|node_h1|4|node|3|node|5|node_1}}, and the [[runcicantic order-5 cubic honeycomb]], {{CDD|node_h1|4|node|3|node_1|5|node_1}}.

The '''runcic order-5 cubic honeycomb''' is a uniform compact space-filling [[tessellation]] (or [[honeycomb (geometry)|honeycomb]]), with [[Schläfli symbol]] h<sub>3</sub>{4,3,5}. It has [[regular dodecahedron|dodecahedron]], [[rhombicosidodecahedron]], and [[tetrahedron]] cells, with a [[triangular frustum]] [[vertex figure]].

The '''runcicantic order-5 cubic honeycomb''' is a uniform compact space-filling [[tessellation]] (or [[honeycomb (geometry)|honeycomb]]), with [[Schläfli symbol]] h<sub>2,3</sub>{4,3,5}. It has [[truncated dodecahedron]], [[truncated icosidodecahedron]], and [[truncated tetrahedron]] cells, with an irregular [[tetrahedron]] [[vertex figure]].
